contract: Parameters [in] maxLength Type: int The maximum length of the string to return, or -1 if no limit is required. [out, retval] text Type: BSTR* Receives a pointer to the string, possibly truncated at the specified maxLength . Return value Type: HRESULT If this method succeeds, it returns S_OK . Otherwise, it returns an HRESULT error code.
meaning: Native API documentation, not Windows execution.
